class: A completion qualifier interrupts a known highest-education question pattern
symptom: ADP's required highest level of completed education dropdown stayed blank despite a saved master's degree, and the runtime repeated Next until its validation-loop breaker stopped it.
site: Church Mutual ADP Preliminary Questions, supervised continuation on 25 October 2026; page_17 and later snapshots in pages/20261025_150804
root_cause: DEGREE_LEVEL recognizes highest level of education but not the intervening completed/attained/achieved qualifier. The field has no required star and reports Add response, so the unknown answer is not surfaced clearly before progression retries.
why_tests_missed: Education tests cover degree options and repeated degree records, but not this wording variant for a single highest-education dropdown.
fix: Add the qualifier variants to canonical concept wording data and reuse the saved degree through existing offered-option matching. During supervision the guarded choice helper selected the offered Master's level degree and verified the displayed value. Unmarked Add response requirement diagnostics remain a separate follow-up.
prevention: Cover common qualifier insertions in question-pattern tests and retain field-level validation evidence independently of visible required markers. Never infer a degree without structured profile evidence.
